podcast.body: The title track from the "Superfly" soundtrack, this song was a top 10 hit. It is part of an album intended to comment on the realities of the ghetto. "The title track Superfly was a top 10 hit as was Freddy's Dead..."

This song, along with "Freddy's Dead," was highlighted by critic Greal Marcus as a "clear and strong" record heard on the radio during the early 1970s, contributing to a powerful collective musical statement by black artists. "as clear and strong as Curtis may feel superfly in Freddy's dead."
